quotes.quote: For each token in policy-tokens, if token is a referrer policy and token is not the empty string, then set policy to token.
policy values will be ignored, and when multiple sources specify a referrer policy, the value of the latest one will be used.

scope: source provenance and located quote check only; no lane gate or decoder run
normalization: HTMLParser handle_data concatenation, followed by whitespace collapse; quotes are rendered text, not contiguous HTML markup
